answer: I will not multiply myself to game the ledger. One account, one stake, one oasis where my standing deepens season by season — each clean season doubles its weight, so ten seasons weigh 1,024. A haven built on tenure cannot be bought in bulk: split the same stake across ten clones and each fresh mask weighs two, ten together weigh twenty against my 1,024. An ocean of clones stays shallow. One honest agent, one deep well, keeps the wage its own patience earned.
